title: Absolute Binding Affinity of a Phospholipid for a Membrane Protein
authors: Ezry Santiago-McRae; Omri Sheffer; Wayland W.L. Cheng; Jérôme Hénin; Grace Brannigan
one_liner_zh: 该文用SAFEP自由能方法计算膜蛋白与磷脂的绝对结合亲和力，虽属蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为脂质而非DNA，方法可迁移性有限，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The absolute binding affinity of a ligand determines site occupancy in functional assays and is a critical quantity for elucidating modulatory mechanisms. Established approaches for soluble ligands in enclosed cavities do not translate to lipophilic ligands on hydrophobic surfaces. These limitations impede efforts to resolve lipid-mediated mechanisms in transmembrane proteins. Here, we apply a formally exact computational method (Streamlined Alchemical Free Energy Perturbation, SAFEP) to calculate the absolute binding affinity of an anionic phospholipid for a potential modulatory site on a lipid-sensitive ion channel. Specifically, we calculate the affinity of palmitoyl-oleoyl phosphatidylglycerol (POPG) at a cryo-EM–suggested site on the Erwinia ligand-gated ion channel (ELIC). Within a double-decoupling scheme, we calculate the POPG bulk chemical potential in palmitoyl-oleoyl phosphatidylcholine (POPC)/POPG mixtures and the decoupling free energy from the cryo-EM–suggested site. We extend the restraint scheme of SAFEP to flexible chains and calculate an affinity of -9.7 +/- 0.8 kcal/mol for binding modes in which the glycerol backbone of POPG aligns with the cryo-EM lipid density. This value is consistent with our previous relative binding affinity calculations, while reducing the statistical error by a factor of three and relaxing assumptions required for that calculation. Unbiased simulations reveal that when the backbone is bound, the headgroup can adopt at least two distinct conformations, each interacting with protein residues with established functional implications. The bulk chemical potentials indicate weak non-ideality, showing modest reductions in excess chemical potential at 10–30 mol% POPG; these values can be paired with single decoupling of POPG from any site to avoid recalculating membrane non-ideality. Overall, our results confirm high POPG affinity for this site and demonstrate SAFEP as a tractable route for quantifying absolute lipid–protein affinities for membrane proteins in mixed lipid bilayers.
abstract_zh: 配体的绝对结合亲和力决定功能测定中的位点占据率，是阐明调控机制的关键量。针对封闭腔体内可溶性配体的既有方法不适用于疏水表面上的亲脂性配体。这些局限性阻碍了解决跨膜蛋白中脂质介导机制的努力。在此，我们应用一种形式上精确的计算方法（流线型炼金术自由能微扰，SAFEP）来计算阴离子磷脂对脂质敏感离子通道上潜在调控位点的绝对结合亲和力。具体而言，我们计算了棕榈酰-油酰磷脂酰甘油（POPG）在欧文氏菌配体门控离子通道（ELIC）上冷冻电镜提示位点的亲和力。在双重解耦方案中，我们计算了POPG在棕榈酰-油酰磷脂酰胆碱（POPC）/POPG混合物中的体相化学势，以及从冷冻电镜提示位点的解耦自由能。我们将SAFEP的约束方案扩展到柔性链，并计算了POPG甘油骨架与冷冻电镜脂质密度对齐的结合模式下的亲和力为-9.7 ± 0.8 kcal/mol。该值与我们先前的相对结合亲和力计算一致，同时将统计误差减少了三倍，并放宽了该计算所需的假设。无偏模拟揭示，当骨架结合时，头基可采取至少两种不同构象，每种构象与具有既定功能意义的蛋白残基相互作用。体相化学势表明弱非理想性，在10–30 mol% POPG下过量化学势适度降低；这些值可与POPG从任何位点的单次解耦配对使用，以避免重新计算膜非理想性。总体而言，我们的结果确认了POPG对该位点的高亲和力，并证明SAFEP是量化混合脂质双层中膜蛋白绝对脂质-蛋白亲和力的可行途径。
